queer_characters.name: Salma
queer_characters.notes: Described as the film's explicitly LGBTQ+ character, a lesbian DJ from a Christian Arab background who conceals her sexual identity from her family, portraying the tension between personal authenticity and familial expectations.

contributor_notes: Source text confirms Salma as the sole explicitly queer character (lesbian). Trigger warnings noted family rejection fears (homophobia); the source also mentions religious persecution/fatwa against the film and cultural/familial pressure, but these do not map cleanly to available enum values. No subtitle or audio language information was provided. No queer creators are identified in the source; director Maysaloun Hamoud's identity is not stated.
